title: Ox Passion Pink Lemon Bubbly Nic Salts E-Liquid 10ml
description: OX Passion Blue Bubble is a nostalgic fusion of sweet Blueberry and classic Bubblegum, creating a smooth and playful vape. The Blueberry note brings a burst of rich, juicy, berry sweetness, while the Bubblegum adds a chewy, confectionery finish that makes for a bright and satisfying flavour with plenty of character. Blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio and infused with nicotine salts, this e-liquid delivers smooth throat hits and rapid nicotine absorption, making it ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) devices. It performs best in pod systems, starter kits, and other low-powered vape pens. Available in both 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, OX Passion Nic Salts offer bold, layered flavour profiles with a consistently smooth finish. Developed by Oxva, a trusted name in vaping hardware, these e-liquids are expertly crafted to pair seamlessly with Oxva XLIM pod kits and other refillable MTL vape devices.
